text:
Lina: FYI SRE will flip back the new routing flag in a controlled rollback at 22:00 PT. We need comms aligned: statuspage language + who gets direct email + a tiny public note if it looks customer-visible.
Amit: Thanks. Scope: routing flag only, no DB changes. Expected impact window ~22:00-22:20 PT. No data exposure.
Tasha: Okay. Plan for 3 artifacts: 1) public statuspage post, 2) targeted email to Dedicated/Private customers who saw degraded performance, 3) short social/Docs banner if it affects docs links.
Jon: I'll own the rollback and will post updates here. If rollback restores normal behavior within 15m we close. If not, we'll escalate to oncall.
Elaine: For segmentation: can you confirm list of customers who hit fallback? We should avoid blasting everyone.
Amit: It's ~4 dedicated accounts + a handful of private deploys. We'll share a CSV to marketing in ~10m.
Lina: Draft statuspage blurb (short): "We're rolling back a recent routing change after detecting higher-than-normal inference latency. The rollback started at 22:00 PT. We've seen partial restoration; we will post a follow-up by 22:25 PT. No customer data was impacted." Thoughts?
Tasha: Tight. Suggest swap "higher-than-normal inference latency" -> "intermittent increased inference latency and occasional 5xx errors" to be explicit. Also add a one-line note for Dedicated: "Dedicated instances may have experienced intermittent errors."
Lina: Revised: "We experienced intermittent increased inference latency and occasional 5xx errors following a routing config rollout. We initiated a rollback at 22:00 PT to restore normal service. Dedicated instances may have experienced intermittent errors. No customer data was impacted. Next update by 22:25 PT."
Jon: Good. Add an ETA for resolution? "Next update" is fine. Keep it short on statuspage.
Elaine: Email subject proposal: "Action: Routing rollback - impact to your Dedicated capacity" Body bullets: 1) what happened, 2) what we did (rollback), 3) action required: none, 4) contact/SLAs. Keep under 3 short paragraphs.
Tasha: Also prepare an internal 1-pager for Support with exact verbiage and canned replies (short). We'll need copy for Intercom and for anyone answering support tickets.
Amit: I'll attach the CSV and include the incident ID INC-2026-043. We'll provide the oncall alias and a support ticket link.
Lina: I'll produce: statuspage post, targeted email draft, support canned replies, and a 2-line public tweet/LinkedIn if we need a broader notice. Need signoff by 21:50 PT so we can queue posts before rollback.
Jon: I'll post a go/no-go at 21:55 PT and will update at 22:10 with progress.
statusbot: Incident INC-2026-043 created. Severity: degraded. Owner: Jon.
Lina: Perfect. I'll drop the drafts here asap for quick thumbs-up. :white_check_mark:
